effect_description_eng:
While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [DM] trait on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) and trash 2 cards in your hand. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・By deleting 1 of your play cost 7 or lower Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with [Kimeramon] or [Millenniummon] in its name from your trash with the play cost reduced by 3.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) and trash 2 cards in your hand. Then, place this card in the battle area.
